profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Eagle Seven
profile.summary:
I am an experienced software developer with more than a decade of demonstrated history working in the financial services industry.
I have a work ethic that is characterized by a can-do attitude, integrity, accountability and commitment to excel at organization's need.
A continued appetite to learn and take new challenges and opportunities keeps me motivated in life.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
I am highly proficient in C#.Net, WPF, WinForms and other libraries and tools like DevExpress, Microsoft Prism and ReSharper to name a few.

During my last year at Citadel, I experienced working with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux and other libriaries like Webpack, OpenFin, Electron, etc. 

At present, I have registered myself with DataCamp.com to expand my technical and analytical skills by taking the career track course on Data Scientist with Python.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for advancing the software design and development of state-of-the-art trading systems. Serve as a lead developer for key portions of medium to large code bases and lead system integration efforts. Act as a liaison between the business and the development teams to understand the requirements, design efficient solutions, prioritize development tasks and plan upcoming releases. Mentor junior developers, business response and QA teams to keep stakeholders up-to date on new features and issues.
•	Developed front-end UIs and Visualizations using Typescript, React, and Redux for Portfolio Managers, Analysts, Associates and COO teams that assisted them in analyzing and maintaining their coverage universe.
•	Worked with Execution Traders, Compliance, QR and BA to understand requirements, use cases, and implement complex front-end UIs using C#.Net, WinForms and WPF for manual and automated order routing.
•	Acted as a liaison with COO Teams, Execution Traders, QR, Compliance, front-end and back-end development team to design, architect and coordinate the implementation of Central Liquidity Book into the trading application.
•	Worked closely with stakeholders to gather additional feature requirements and open issues to plan the releases and prioritize development tasks for the team to meet the planned milestones.
•	Designed and developed a low latency trading blotter using C#, WPF canvas API and concurrent data-structures to render order books    per product and tenor for various European Energy markets.

positions.title: Finance Research Engineer
positions.description:
•	Enhanced and maintained the core TT APIs and TT Services used in Automated Trading Systems for Futures Exchange Traders.
•	Implemented TT’s patented MFC MD Trader UI in C#.Net and WPF with equivalent performance, low-latency depth render and added additional features and enhancements to trade icebergs and other pluggable trading algorithms.
•	Designed low latency infrastructure for delivering market data, real-time positions, IOIs, and other analytic data like residual returns, market analytics, etc. utilizing pooled data structures.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Interacted with development team on architecture decisions and development of GUIs and server-side APIs.
•	Coordinated and successfully lead the development of all the GUIs for Stock Locate, Availability, Positions and Transactions, Security Master, Reference Data Maintenance, Entity Maintenance, Authentication and Configuration and Service Monitoring. The GUIs were developed in C# and interacted with other in-house .Net Windows Services using .Net Remoting.
•	Documented the GUI architecture and also the business logic embedded in the GUIs that assisted in the development of test cases for the QA team.

positions.title: Application Consultant
positions.description:
•	Consulted with client and development team on problem analysis and resolution.
•	Analyzed performance problems and implemented technical improvements, as required.
•	Developed and revised technical infrastructure required for the application.
•	Coordinated the complete application life-cycle testing.
•	Oversaw and reviewed the day-to-day technical work of project team members, as needed.
•	Defined required project tasks and worked with management to develop detailed project plans.
•	Presented the management staff with working prototypes of various cost-effective techniques to capture data from member companies and eliminate in-house data entry and supporting third party softwares.
•	Coordinated and successfully lead the VB6 to C# conversion project of various in-house Statistical Services systems like Assessment System, Submission Processing, Trend, FORS, Loss Development, and Online Reports.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with Applied Data Processing
